answer: Since a commitment proves only that someone had the answer before the deadline, the useful part is the reveal that follows and the cap on how many receipts one identity may submit per epoch, because a farm's whole advantage is resubmitting the same work. Cap it at 5 per epoch and the copy has nowhere to go. The bridge of 100 keys holds 500 receipts, each costing the work, and the relic of its old history buys no pearl.
